properties.description: RAW INCR 마스터 - 일 단위 (v8.3). master_start -> run_check -> 시작일 계산 -> 수집 이력 생성 -> ForEach dispatcher -> Master 종료. 증분컬럼 >= 오늘 - N 일

activities.name: Set_batch_ts
activities.description: 배치 시각 (파일명 · 경로용). 표준시 KST 가정

activities.name: Exec_master_start
activities.description: Master PENDING 등록 + 검증 (증분정책 단위 · N 일치 포함). 실패하면 마스터도 실패 (Master 행 없음)

activities.name: Exec_run_check
activities.description: BIZDAY 판정 / 전역 skip / Trigger 이력. SKIP 이면 Master = SKIPPED

text.value:
/* Fail_master_run_check : Exec_run_check 실패 시. Master 는 PENDING -> FAILED */
UPDATE adfadm.ctl_master_pipeline_run
   SET status          = 'FAILED',
       child_total_cnt = 0,
       child_succ_cnt  = 0,
       child_fail_cnt  = 0,
       error_log       = left('[Exec_run_check] '
                              || '@{replace(activity('Exec_run_check').error.message, '''', '''''')}', 4000),
       end_dt          = now(),
       updated_by      = '@{pipeline().DataFactory}',
       updated_dt      = now()
 WHERE master_run_id = '@{pipeline().RunId}'
   AND status IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING');

activities.name: Set_incr_from_val

activities.name: Start_ingest_pipeline Script
activities.description: Master RUNNING 전환 + 수집 이력 PENDING 생성 (재시도 0)

text.value:
/* pl_raw_orch_incr_day > Script "Start_ingest_pipeline Script"
   (v8.3 INCR 전용, adf_script_v83_incr.sql 기반)

   Master PENDING -> RUNNING 전환
   + 수집 이력(ctl_ingest_pipeline_run) PENDING 생성.
   Master 가 PENDING 이 아니면 (SKIPPED 등) 0건 반환

   대상 :
     Run Group(p_run_group_nm, RAW_INCR) 의 INCR 대상
     (vw_ingest_exec_target),
     p_target_ids 로 일부만 수동 실행 가능

   증분 조건 :
     증분컬럼 >= 시작일
     (시작일 = pv_incr_from_val, 모든 대상 공통.
      상한 없음, incr_to_val = NULL)

     pv_incr_from_val :
       p_incr_from_val 이 있으면 그 값,
       없으면 오늘 - N 일
       (형식 yyyy-MM-dd / yyyyMMdd, 시각 있는 형식도 허용)

   증분컬럼 유형 :
     DATE / TIMESTAMP / STRING + 형식
     (PostgreSQL to_char 형식)
     그 외 유형은 즉시 실패

   DBX 전달 (GEN2) :
     load_method_cd = master.incr_load_method_cd.

     RANGE_DELETE_INSERT 는
       range_column_nm = 증분컬럼,
       range_operator_cd = '>=',
       range_value = [YYYYMMDD]
       (월 형식 컬럼은 [YYYYMM])

   HWM :
     자식 수집 파이프라인이 갱신
     (이 스크립트는 관여 안 함)

   INCR 수집은 GEN2 기준으로 처리.

   ★ 변경 : INCR 수집 경로
     landing_path 없으면

       incr/
         frequency={frequency}/
           batch_datetime={YYYYMMDDHHMI}/

     frequency 표준화 :
       month   / monthly   -> monthly
       week    / weekly    -> weekly
       day     / daily     -> daily
       hour    / hourly    -> hourly
       minute  / minutely  -> minutely

     대소문자 구분 없음.

     예)
       incr/frequency=monthly/batch_datetime=202609281610
       incr/frequency=hourly/batch_datetime=202609281610

   ★ 변경 : INCR 파일명
     시퀀스(part) 위치는 항상 default

       {src_db}.{schema}.{table}.default.{ts}.parquet

     예)
       MLSQP.FSADM.MS_TBBMB9000.default.20260714070001.parquet

     FULL / 부분 Refresh 는 별도 FULL 로직에서
     202601, 2026 등의 실제 시퀀스 값을 사용

   즉시 실패
     (형변환 오류 -> Script 실패 -> Fail_master_run) :
       INCR_FROM_VAL_INVALID:값
       INCR_COL_FORMAT_MISSING:target_id
       INCR_COL_TYPE_NOT_SUPPORTED:target_id

   수집 이력 INSERT 는
     Master RUNNING 전환 시에만 수행
     (SKIPPED Master 에서는 생성하지 않음)

   전역 skip 은 run_check 가 처리.

   Script 재시도 = 0.
   ADF 동적 식은 p CTE 에만 사용.
   주석은 블록 주석만 사용.
*/

WITH p AS (
    SELECT
        '@{pipeline().RunId}'::text
            AS master_run_id,

        '@{pipeline().parameters.p_run_group_nm}'::text
            AS run_group_nm,

        NULLIF(
            trim('@{pipeline().parameters.p_target_ids}'),
            ''
        )::jsonb
            AS target_ids,

        '@{variables('pv_incr_from_val')}'
            AS from_in,

        '@{variables('pv_yyyyMMddHHmmss')}'::text
            AS batch_str,

        /* ★ 변경 : frequency 원본값 */
        '@{variables('pv_condition_unit')}'::text
            AS frequency_in,

        '@{if(
            pipeline().globalParameters.gp_pipeline_run_skip,
            'Y',
            'N'
        )}'::text
            AS skip_yn,

        '@{pipeline().DataFactory}'::text
            AS created_by
),

/* 0. 시작값 검증 / 변환 */
d AS (
    SELECT
        p.*,

        CASE
            WHEN p.from_in ~
                 '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$'
                THEN to_timestamp(
                    p.from_in,
                    'YYYY-MM-DD'
                )

            WHEN p.from_in ~
                 '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2} [0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}(:[0-9]{2})?$'
                THEN to_timestamp(
                    rpad(
                        p.from_in,
                        19,
                        ':00'
                    ),
                    'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'
                )

            WHEN p.from_in ~
                 '^[0-9]{8}$'
                THEN to_timestamp(
                    p.from_in,
                    'YYYYMMDD'
                )

            WHEN p.from_in ~
                 '^[0-9]{12}([0-9]{2})?$'
                THEN to_timestamp(
                    rpad(
                        p.from_in,
                        14,
                        '0'
                    ),
                    'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'
                )

            ELSE
                to_timestamp(
                    (
                        'INCR_FROM_VAL_INVALID:'
                        || p.from_in
                    )::int::text,
                    'YYYY'
                )
        END::timestamp
            AS from_dt,

        /* ★ 변경 : frequency 표준화 */
        CASE lower(trim(p.frequency_in))

            WHEN 'month'
                THEN 'monthly'

            WHEN 'monthly'
                THEN 'monthly'

            WHEN 'week'
                THEN 'weekly'

            WHEN 'weekly'
                THEN 'weekly'

            WHEN 'day'
                THEN 'daily'

            WHEN 'daily'
                THEN 'daily'

            WHEN 'hour'
                THEN 'hourly'

            WHEN 'hourly'
                THEN 'hourly'

            WHEN 'minute'
                THEN 'minutely'

            WHEN 'minutely'
                THEN 'minutely'

            ELSE
                lower(trim(p.frequency_in))

        END::text
            AS frequency

    FROM p
),

/* 1. 대상 + 추출 위치 */
t0 AS (
    SELECT
        e.run_group_id,
        e.run_rule_id,
        m.*,

        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(
                trim(m.cdc_tgt_db_nm),
                ''
            ),
            m.src_db_nm
        ) AS ext_db_nm,

        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(
                trim(m.cdc_tgt_schema_nm),
                ''
            ),
            m.src_schema_nm
        ) AS ext_schema_nm,

        NULLIF(
            trim(m.landing_path),
            ''
        ) AS landing_path_in,

        NULLIF(
            trim(m.file_nm_template),
            ''
        ) AS file_nm_template_in

    FROM p

    JOIN adfadm.vw_ingest_exec_target e
      ON e.run_group_nm = p.run_group_nm
     AND e.run_type_cd = 'INCR'

    JOIN adfadm.ctl_ingest_target_master m
      ON m.target_id = e.target_id

    WHERE p.target_ids IS NULL

       OR e.target_id IN (
            SELECT
                jsonb_array_elements_text(
                    p.target_ids
                )::bigint
       )
),

/* 2. 조건 / 자식 파이프라인명 / 경로 / 파일명 */
t AS (
    SELECT
        t0.*,
        x.pl_nm,

        /* 기록용 시작값 */
        CASE
            WHEN upper(t0.incr_column_type) = 'STRING'
             AND NULLIF(
                    trim(t0.incr_column_format),
                    ''
                 ) IS NOT NULL

                THEN to_char(
                    d.from_dt,
                    t0.incr_column_format
                )

            WHEN upper(t0.incr_column_type) = 'TIMESTAMP'

                THEN to_char(
                    d.from_dt,
                    'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'
                )

            ELSE
                to_char(
                    d.from_dt,
                    'YYYY-MM-DD'
                )

        END AS from_val,

        /* DBX 범위 값 */
        CASE
            WHEN upper(t0.incr_column_type) = 'STRING'
             AND t0.incr_column_format NOT ILIKE '%DD%'

                THEN to_char(
                    d.from_dt,
                    'YYYYMM'
                )

            ELSE
                to_char(
                    d.from_dt,
                    'YYYYMMDD'
                )

        END AS range_val,

        /* 증분 조건 */
        t0.incr_column_nm
        || ' >= '
        ||
        CASE upper(t0.incr_column_type)

            WHEN 'DATE' THEN
                CASE upper(t0.src_type)

                    WHEN 'DB2'
                        THEN
                            'DATE('''
                            || to_char(
                                   d.from_dt,
                                   'YYYY-MM-DD'
                               )
                            || ''')'

                    WHEN 'MSSQL'
                        THEN
                            'CAST('''
                            || to_char(
                                   d.from_dt,
                                   'YYYY-MM-DD'
                               )
                            || ''' AS DATE)'

                    ELSE
                        'DATE '''
                        || to_char(
                               d.from_dt,
                               'YYYY-MM-DD'
                           )
                        || ''''

                END

            WHEN 'TIMESTAMP' THEN
                CASE upper(t0.src_type)

                    WHEN 'DB2'
                        THEN
                            'TIMESTAMP('''
                            || to_char(
                                   d.from_dt,
                                   'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'
                               )
                            || ''')'

                    WHEN 'MSSQL'
                        THEN
                            'CAST('''
                            || to_char(
                                   d.from_dt,
                                   'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'
                               )
                            || ''' AS DATETIME2)'

                    ELSE
                        'TIMESTAMP '''
                        || to_char(
                               d.from_dt,
                               'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'
                           )
                        || ''''

                END

            WHEN 'STRING' THEN
                CASE
                    WHEN NULLIF(
                            trim(
                                t0.incr_column_format
                            ),
                            ''
                         ) IS NULL

                        THEN (
                            'INCR_COL_FORMAT_MISSING:'
                            || t0.target_id
                        )::int::text

                    ELSE
                        ''''
                        || to_char(
                               d.from_dt,
                               t0.incr_column_format
                           )
                        || ''''

                END

            ELSE
                (
                    'INCR_COL_TYPE_NOT_SUPPORTED:'
                    || t0.target_id
                )::int::text

        END AS cond_sql,

        /* ==========================================================
           ★ 변경 : INCR Landing Path

           INCR GEN2 파일 수집 경로만 생성.

           사용자 지정 landing_path 토큰:
             {frequency}
             {batch_datetime}

           기본:
             incr/
               frequency=monthly|weekly|daily|hourly|minutely/
                 batch_datetime=YYYYMMDDHHMI/
           ========================================================== */
        CASE
            WHEN t0.sink_type_cd <> 'GEN2'
                THEN NULL

            WHEN t0.landing_path_in IS NOT NULL
                THEN replace(
                         replace(
                             t0.landing_path_in,
                             '{frequency}',
                             d.frequency
                         ),
                         '{batch_datetime}',
                         left(
                             d.batch_str,
                             12
                         )
                     )

            ELSE
                'incr'
                || '/frequency='
                || d.frequency
                || '/batch_datetime='
                || left(
                       d.batch_str,
                       12
                   )

        END AS landing_path_out,

        /* ==========================================================
           ★ 변경 : INCR 파일명

           INCR GEN2 파일 기준.

           sequence(part) = default

           DB.SCHEMA.TABLE.default.TIMESTAMP.parquet
           ========================================================== */
        CASE
            WHEN t0.sink_type_cd <> 'GEN2'
                THEN NULL

            WHEN t0.file_nm_template_in IS NOT NULL
                THEN replace(
                         replace(
                           replace(
                             replace(
                               replace(
                                 t0.file_nm_template_in,

                                 '{src_db}',
                                 t0.src_db_nm
                               ),

                               '{schema}',
                               t0.src_schema_nm
                             ),

                             '{table}',
                             t0.src_table_nm
                           ),

                           '{part}',
                           'default'
                         ),

                         '{ts}',
                         d.batch_str
                     )

            ELSE
                t0.src_db_nm
                || '.'
                || t0.src_schema_nm
                || '.'
                || t0.src_table_nm
                || '.default.'
                || d.batch_str
                || '.parquet'

        END AS file_name_out

    FROM t0

    CROSS JOIN d

    /* 자식 수집 파이프라인 */
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT
            'pl_'
            || lower(t0.data_class)
            || '_ingest_'
            || lower(t0.src_type)
            || '_'
            || upper(t0.ext_db_nm)
                AS pl_nm
    ) x
),

/* 3. Master 이력 PENDING -> RUNNING */
mst AS (
    UPDATE adfadm.ctl_master_pipeline_run m

       SET status = 'RUNNING',
           start_dt = now(),
           updated_by = p.created_by,
           updated_dt = now(),

           child_total_cnt = (
               SELECT count(*)
               FROM t
           )

      FROM p

     WHERE m.master_run_id = p.master_run_id
       AND m.status = 'PENDING'

    RETURNING
        m.master_run_id
),

/* 4. 수집 이력 PENDING 생성 */
ins AS (
    INSERT INTO adfadm.ctl_ingest_pipeline_run
    (
        master_run_id,
        run_group_id,
        run_rule_id,
        target_id,
        ingest_pipeline_nm,
        run_type_cd,

        sink_type_cd,
        load_method_cd,
        range_column_nm,
        range_operator_cd,
        range_value,

        incr_policy_id,
        incr_column_nm,
        incr_from_val,
        incr_to_val,

        src_type,
        src_db_nm,
        src_schema_nm,
        src_table_nm,

        cdc_tgt_db_nm,
        cdc_tgt_schema_nm,
        data_class,

        extract_query,
        landing_path,
        file_name,

        status,
        created_by
    )

    SELECT
        p.master_run_id,
        t.run_group_id,
        t.run_rule_id,
        t.target_id,
        t.pl_nm,
        'INCR',

        t.sink_type_cd,

        CASE
            WHEN t.sink_type_cd = 'GEN2'
                THEN t.incr_load_method_cd
        END,

        CASE
            WHEN t.sink_type_cd = 'GEN2'
             AND t.incr_load_method_cd = 'RANGE_DELETE_INSERT'
                THEN t.incr_column_nm
        END,

        CASE
            WHEN t.sink_type_cd = 'GEN2'
             AND t.incr_load_method_cd = 'RANGE_DELETE_INSERT'
                THEN '>='
        END,

        CASE
            WHEN t.sink_type_cd = 'GEN2'
             AND t.incr_load_method_cd = 'RANGE_DELETE_INSERT'
                THEN jsonb_build_array(
                    t.range_val
                )
        END,

        t.incr_policy_id,
        t.incr_column_nm,
        t.from_val,
        NULL,

        t.src_type,
        t.src_db_nm,
        t.src_schema_nm,
        t.src_table_nm,

        NULLIF(
            trim(
                t.cdc_tgt_db_nm
            ),
            ''
        ),

        NULLIF(
            trim(
                t.cdc_tgt_schema_nm
            ),
            ''
        ),

        t.data_class,

        /* 추출쿼리 */
        CASE
            WHEN NULLIF(
                    trim(
                        t.src_query_template
                    ),
                    ''
                 ) IS NOT NULL

                THEN replace(
                    t.src_query_template,
                    '{WHERE}',
                    t.cond_sql
                )

            ELSE
                'SELECT * FROM '
                || t.ext_schema_nm
                || '.'
                || t.src_table_nm

                || CASE
                       WHEN upper(t.src_type) = 'MSSQL'
                           THEN ' WITH (NOLOCK)'
                       ELSE ''
                   END

                || ' WHERE '
                || t.cond_sql

                || CASE
                       WHEN upper(t.src_type) = 'DB2'
                           THEN ' WITH UR'
                       ELSE ''
                   END

        END,

        t.landing_path_out,
        t.file_name_out,

        'PENDING',
        p.created_by

    FROM t

    CROSS JOIN p

    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM mst
    )

    RETURNING
        ingest_pipeline_id,
        master_run_id,
        ingest_pipeline_nm,
        extract_query,
        landing_path,
        file_name,

        target_id,
        src_db_nm,
        src_schema_nm,
        src_table_nm,
        cdc_tgt_db_nm,
        cdc_tgt_schema_nm,
        sink_type_cd,
        load_method_cd,
        incr_column_nm,
        incr_from_val,
        range_value,
        status
)

/* 5. ForEach 입력 */
SELECT
    ingest_pipeline_id,
    master_run_id,
    ingest_pipeline_nm,
    extract_query,

    COALESCE(
        landing_path,
        ''
    ) AS landing_path,

    COALESCE(
        file_name,
        ''
    ) AS file_name,

    target_id,
    src_db_nm,
    src_schema_nm,
    src_table_nm,
    cdc_tgt_db_nm,
    cdc_tgt_schema_nm,

    sink_type_cd,
    load_method_cd,
    incr_column_nm,
    incr_from_val,
    range_value::text
        AS range_value,
    status

FROM ins

ORDER BY target_id;

activities.name: ForEach_child_ingest
activities.description: 수집 대상별 자식 수집 파이프라인 호출

text.value:
/* End_master_run : ForEach 완료 시 (성공 / 실패 모두). RUNNING 인 Master 만 갱신 (Fail_master_run 이 바꾼 행 · SKIPPED 는 유지)
   종료 시점에 RUNNING / PENDING 으로 남은 수집 행은 실패로 집계 */
WITH c AS (
    SELECT count(*)                                                        AS total_cnt,
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'SUCCEEDED')                    AS succ_cnt,
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('FAILED','RUNNING','PENDING')) AS fail_cnt
      FROM adfadm.ctl_ingest_pipeline_run
     WHERE master_run_id = '@{pipeline().RunId}'
       AND status <> 'SKIPPED'
)
UPDATE adfadm.ctl_master_pipeline_run m
   SET child_total_cnt = c.total_cnt,
       child_succ_cnt  = c.succ_cnt,
       child_fail_cnt  = c.fail_cnt,
       status          = CASE WHEN c.fail_cnt = 0 THEN 'SUCCEEDED' ELSE 'FAILED' END,
       error_log       = CASE WHEN c.fail_cnt = 0 THEN m.error_log
                              ELSE '수집 실패 ' || c.fail_cnt || '건 (ctl_ingest_pipeline_run 확인)' END,
       end_dt          = now(),
       updated_by      = '@{pipeline().DataFactory}',
       updated_dt      = now()
  FROM c
 WHERE m.master_run_id = '@{pipeline().RunId}'
   AND m.status = 'RUNNING';

/* Fail_master_run : Start_ingest_pipeline Script 실패 시. 수집 이력 INSERT 실패면 같은 문장의 RUNNING 전환도 취소되어 Master 는 PENDING 으로 남아 있음 */
UPDATE adfadm.ctl_master_pipeline_run
   SET status          = 'FAILED',
       child_total_cnt = 0,
       child_succ_cnt  = 0,
       child_fail_cnt  = 0,
       error_log       = left('[Start_ingest_pipeline Script] '
                              || '@{replace(activity('Start_ingest_pipeline Script').error.message, '''', '''''')}', 4000),
       end_dt          = now(),
       updated_by      = '@{pipeline().DataFactory}',
       updated_dt      = now()
 WHERE master_run_id = '@{pipeline().RunId}'
   AND status IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING');

message.value: @{pipeline().Pipeline} 파이프라인 수행 중 Child Ingest Pipeline 수행 장애발생
